title: post-tool-advisory's no-findings guard can never fire: critic always writes header lines to stdout, so a wired advisory hook prints on every Write/Edit
body:
**RESTORED ARCHAEOLOGY, TRANSCRIBED VERBATIM ON 2026-08-31.** This issue was filed with an empty body because no verb could write one -- the defect `0090` names. Its finding survived in `vc`'s board, written in the same commit that created this empty record: `7725033e` (*issue(0085): a parity suite proves two binaries agree and cannot prove either is useful to its caller*). The quoted text below is `vc`'s own, carried whole. **Nothing in it is written by the restorer.**

> - **A PARITY SUITE PROVES TWO BINARIES AGREE; IT CANNOT PROVE EITHER ONE IS USEFUL TO ITS CALLER** (dc). The mirror of the `session-finish` class and **invisible to every instrument the estate has**: `post-tool-advisory.sh:73`'s `[ -z "$findings" ]` guard CANNOT FIRE, because `critic` always writes header lines to stdout -- **so no roster disagrees with any roster, all lists are in perfect agreement, and the hook still prints on every Write/Edit**, which `session-finish.sh:46` names as the thing a hook must not do. Filed `0085`. **Finding it needed someone to run the command and read WHICH STREAM the bytes came out of.**
